concepts.title: 在……呢 (zài...ne) — Actions Happening Right Now
concepts.explanation: Use 在 before a verb and 呢 at the end to show an action is happening right now.
concepts.note: 在 marks ongoing action. 呢 adds a natural 'right now' feeling.

concepts.title: Negative Form with 没在 (méi zài)
concepts.explanation: Use 没在 before the verb to say an action is not happening right now.
concepts.note: Use 没, not 不, for ongoing actions.

concepts.title: Question Form with 吗 (ma)
concepts.explanation: Add 吗 at the end of the sentence to ask whether an action is happening.
concepts.note: Chinese questions usually keep the same word order.

concepts.title: 做什么 (zuò shénme) — What are you doing?
concepts.explanation: Use 在做什么 to ask what someone is doing right now.
concepts.note: 什么 stays in the same position as the answer.

vocab.en: to be in the middle of doing
